citations.quote:
[name="阿米娅"]嗯，坠落的那一刻，我隐约感觉到了。
[name="阿米娅"]骸骨中残余的，那古老而巨大的意志……游开了。它去了一个我触碰不到的地方。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#2$1",focus="none")]
[Decision(options="它真死了？;它自由了？", values="1;2")]
[Predicate(references="1;2")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]……它与我们之间的联系断了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]或许是暂时的，但时间久了，我们很可能彻底失去对它的掌控。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]你的推测是正确的。Logos检查过了，萨卡兹加诸这具骸骨的巫术正被一股庞大的能量干扰。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]看来血魔的仪式确实完成了。赦罪师……奎萨图什塔正在帮助特雷西斯，实现萨卡兹数千年来都未能做到的事。
[name="凯尔希"]（古老的萨卡兹语）“阿喃那”。万古不愈之创，苦难的摇篮。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]多说点能听懂的，我等着呢。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]它是最初的诅咒，也是最初的源石。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]……这不是传说中的玩意儿吗？赫德雷天天爱看的故事书里胡编的那种。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]传说是真实的影子，尽管它已经被涂抹得面目全非。更何况，这传说来自萨卡兹，甚至是提卡兹。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]听起来特雷西斯打算弄个不得了的东西挂在维多利亚头顶。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]恐怕，这也是他选择伦蒂尼姆作为自己落脚之处的原因。碎片大厦影响天灾与源石的能力已足够成为“阿喃那”的道标。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]在如今的泰拉，它也几乎只可能在这里降临。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]说吧，该怎么拆了它？

[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n小小的黑羽，遮挡了所有人的眼睛。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]

[charslot]
[dialog]
[name="？？？"]回去。
[dialog]

[PlaySound(key="$p_imp_whip_h", volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_land_impact")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0.95, g=0.95, b=0.95, fadetime=0.25, block=true)]

[name="？？？"]结构真脆弱，看来特雷西斯的剑比想象中还要锋利。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=2)]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_179_cgbird_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="夜莺"]闪灵，小心！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]丽兹，没事，他伤不到我。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]你退步了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#4$1",focus="m")]

[charslot]
[dialog]

[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n丰盛的羽毛覆盖在健硕的躯干上，闪耀着光泽。",block = true)]

[Sticker(id="st1")]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]我们已经来到了那扇大门之前。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]哪怕尚只是轻叩大门，就已经大大加快了我们实验的进度。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]最后的仪式你必须出席——
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]

[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]

[charslot]
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#2$1",focus="m",duration=1)]

[CameraShake(duration=5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#4$1",focus="m")]

[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_land_impact")]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]……唔。
